deploy-bot: Starting deploy for release/ff-routing-v3 @ 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/ff-routing-v3

deploy-bot: Planned feature flag flow for routing-v3: ENABLE 5% -> WAIT 10m -> 25% (HOLD 15m) -> 50% -> 100%. Canary pinned to model v2.2. Auto-fallback to routing-v2 on error-threshold.

alex: I'll watch /api/infer p95, 4xx/5xx, and token cost. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/infra/inference-overview

jen: +1. Add a manual holdpoint at 25% to validate quality/regressions. Gate criteria: error-rate < 2% and p95 latency delta < +15% vs baseline. If either fails, rollback to 0% and pin traffic back to routing-v2.

matt: Canary is pinned: `rbctl pin --target canary --version v2.2` — leaving note in release doc. After 50% we can unpin if stable.

sara: Ops runbook: immediate kill command if needed: `ffctl set routing-v3 off --force` — also can disable via Console > Feature Flags. deploy-bot will auto-disable if error_rate > 2% for 60s.

oncall: Oncall here, I'm online for the window. Alerting: #incidents paging on >2% errors or >25% traffic latency increase.

jen: Also adding a quick smoke test set (prompt set + eval) to validate output quality at 25% hold. If regression Y/N fails, we stop.

deploy-bot: Enabled routing-v3 at 5% (cohort A) — success :white_check_mark: (1757777795)

alex: Seeing small latency uptick in canary, nothing alarming. Watching closely.

matt: Heads-up — throttling config for v3 is slightly lower, expecting slight p95 drift until we scale pools.

jen: Ok, proceed to 25% when we hit 10m and smoke tests pass. I'll post back with go/no-go.

sara: Copy. Standby for quick kill if alert fires.

oncall: Ready.

jen: GO -> moving to 25% now. Command: `ffctl set routing-v3 on --percent=25` (1757777850)

deploy-bot: routing-v3 at 25% — holdpoint engaged (auto-hold 15m). Monitoring channels: #eng-sre #prod-observability.

alex: Smoke tests running... all green so far.

jen: If stable at end of hold, plan to continue to 50% then full. If regress, we'll run `ffctl set routing-v3 off --force` and `rbctl pin --target all --version v2.2`.

matt: Thanks all — will update release notes with final rollout timestamp once we finish.
